settings.label: Prize tables, tee gifts, client bags, and team sets.
One accent color makes group gifts look planned.

settings.title: Make the table look intentional.
settings.text: Use a tight color system so towels, markers, and desk gifts look like a set instead of leftovers.

settings.title: Golf gifts can still feel polished.
settings.text: Avoid novelty-first pieces. Use clean accessories that work on or off the course.

settings.title: Build repeatable kits.
settings.text: For groups, choose a safe base and one event accent so every kit feels connected.

settings.title: Pick the event color
settings.text: Use the event, club, or sponsor color as the accent.

settings.title: Choose the prize tier
settings.text: Small tier: tools and markers. Mid tier: towels and brushes. Premium tier: fuller kit or desk bundle.

settings.title: Keep the table clean
settings.text: Repeat the same color story across all prize levels.
